title: Print your business cards
summary: Free business cards in your own colours. The QR opens your page, so people can see your work and book.

steps.title: Open Business cards
steps.body: On a phone, tap More, then Cards & posters, then Business cards. On a computer, it's Cards & posters in the menu on the left. Your card is already made from your page: your logo, name, number, Instagram and where you are.

steps.title: Pick a style
steps.body: Tap Change design and choose Classic, Photo, Minimal or Bold. Photo puts one of the photos from your page on the front. Tap the card to see the back.

steps.title: Choose whose card it is
steps.body: It can be the business's card, or a card for someone on your team with their name and role on the back. Every card has the same QR to your page. To make another, tap "Make a card for someone on your team".

steps.title: Print it
steps.body: Tap "For a printer" to get a file any printer can use, with the edges and cut marks they need. Ask for thick card (400–450gsm), matte or soft-touch. Or tap "A4 sheet, 10 cards" to print at home or at a business centre: print both pages on one sheet, two-sided, then cut along the marks.

tips: Change your number or Instagram on your page and your card follows. Print again to get the new details on paper.
The QR keeps working even if you change your page link or remove the card, so cards you've handed out never go dead.
Business cards shows how many people scanned your cards this month.
